# Vessel Data Preparation

## Loading all required packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(terra)
library(APCalign)
library(glmmTMB)
library(easystats)
library(ggeffects)
library(scales)
```

## Importing and name-matching data
```{r}
vessel_areas_2023 <- read.csv("data/vessel_measurements.csv", header = T) 
vessel_areas_2026 <- read.csv("data/2026_measurements.csv", header = T) 

vessel_areas <- bind_rows(vessel_areas_2023, vessel_areas_2026) |>  
  separate(Image, c("family_original", "other"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") |>
  separate(other, c("species_name", "state", "other"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") |>
  mutate(area_mm = Area.µm.2/1000000,
         radius = sqrt(Area.µm.2/pi))

rm(vessel_areas_2023, vessel_areas_2026)
gc()

resources <- load_taxonomic_resources()     # Used for ausflora functions

apc_names <- align_taxa(unique(vessel_areas$species_name), resources = resources) %>% 
  update_taxonomy(resources = resources)
apc_names_native <- native_anywhere_in_australia(apc_names$accepted_name, resources = resources)
apc_names <- apc_names %>% left_join(apc_names_native, by = c("accepted_name" = "species"), multiple = "first")

# apc_names %>% group_by(family, native_anywhere_in_aus) %>% summarise (n = n()) %>% View()

vessel_areas <- vessel_areas %>% left_join(apc_names %>% dplyr::select(original_name, accepted_name, genus, family, native_anywhere_in_aus), by = c("species_name" = "original_name")) %>% filter(native_anywhere_in_aus == "native")


# Updated taxonomy used for GBIF occurrence species name
# write.csv(apc_names %>% filter(native_anywhere_in_aus == "native") %>% 
#           dplyr::select(accepted_name) %>% 
#           rename(scientificName = accepted_name), "data/apc_names.csv", row.names = F)
# apc_names <- read.csv("data/apc_names.csv", header = T)

gbif_names <- read.csv("data/gbif_namematched.csv", header = T) |> filter(grepl("SPECIES|VARIETY", rank)) 

vessel_areas <- vessel_areas |> 
  left_join(gbif_names %>% dplyr::select(species, verbatimScientificName, scientificName), by = c("accepted_name" = "verbatimScientificName"), multiple = "first") %>% rename(apc_name = accepted_name, gbif_name = species) |> filter(!state %in% c("kb", "PNG", "1"))
```

## Creating climate preference data for all native tracheophytes
```{r}
library(arrow)
# Filtering columns from GBIF occurrences for RAM and processing time consideration

## Converting very large CSV to parquet
# gbif_occurrences <- fread("data/gbif_raw_occs.csv", header=T, sep="\t")
# write_parquet(gbif_occurrences, "data/gbif_raw_occs.parquet")

# gbif_occurrences <- read_parquet("data/gbif_raw_occs.parquet")
# 
# gbif_filtered <- gbif_occurrences |>
#   filter(grepl("SPECIES|VARIETY", taxonRank)) |> 
#   dplyr::select(family, genus, species, scientificName, decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, coordinateUncertaintyInMeters) |>
#   drop_na() |> 
#   filter(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters <= 10000)

# write_parquet(gbif_filtered, "data/gbif_filtered.parquet")

# Loading and extracting rasters----

library(data.table)

# Creating point vector for each occurrence
gbif_filtered <- read_parquet("data/gbif_filtered.parquet") |> filter(coordinateUncertaintyInMeters <= 1000)

# Create points once
occurrence_points <- vect(gbif_filtered, geom = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"))

# Load all rasters as a single stack (one read pass, shared memory)
raster_stack <- list.files("rasters_30s/", full.names = TRUE) |>
  rast()  # terra::rast() accepts a vector of paths → stacks them

# Extract all layers at once (single pass over points)
extracted <- terra::extract(raster_stack, occurrence_points, ID = FALSE)

# Bind columns once instead of mutating in a loop
gbif_filtered <- cbind(gbif_filtered, extracted)

rm(extracted)
gc()

# Filter and summarise
tracheophyte_climate_preferences <- gbif_filtered |>
  group_by(family, genus, species, scientificName) |>
  summarise(
    MAP = mean(wc2.1_30s_bio_12, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAT = mean(wc2.1_30s_bio_1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  distinct()

tracheophyte_taxa <- create_taxonomic_update_lookup(tracheophyte_climate_preferences$scientificName, resources = resources)
tracheophyte_native_taxa <- native_anywhere_in_australia(tracheophyte_taxa$suggested_name, resources = resources) |> left_join(tracheophyte_taxa, by = c("species" = "suggested_name"), multiple = "first") |> filter(native_anywhere_in_aus == "native")


tracheophyte_climate_preferences <- tracheophyte_climate_preferences |> filter(scientificName %in% tracheophyte_native_taxa$original_name)

rm(gbif_filtered)
gc()

# write.csv(tracheophyte_climate_preferences, "data/tracheophyte_climate_preferences.csv", row.names = F)
```


## Creating climate preferences for sample species
```{r}
# Creating point vector for each occurrence
data_AU <- read_parquet("data/gbif_sample_occs.parquet") |> 
  filter(
    countryCode == "AU" & 
      year >=1900 & 
      coordinateUncertaintyInMeters <= 1000
    )

# Create points once
occurrence_points <- vect(data_AU, geom = c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude"))

# Load all rasters as a single stack (one read pass, shared memory)
raster_stack <- list.files("rasters_30s/", full.names = TRUE) |>
  rast()  # terra::rast() accepts a vector of paths → stacks them

# Extract all layers at once (single pass over points)
extracted <- terra::extract(raster_stack, occurrence_points, ID = FALSE)

# Bind columns once instead of mutating in a loop
data_AU <- cbind(data_AU, extracted)

rm(extracted)
gc()

# Filter and summarise
climate_preferences <- data_AU |>
  filter(scientificName %in% gbif_names$scientificName) |>
  group_by(family, genus, species, scientificName) |>
  summarise(
    MAP = mean(wc2.1_30s_bio_12, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAT = mean(wc2.1_30s_bio_1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  distinct()

rm(data_AU)
rm(occurrence_points)
rm(raster_stack)
gc()

# write.csv(climate_preferences, "data/climate_preferences.csv", row.names = F)

```

## Calculating Dh and VLF
```{r}
xylem_Dh <- vessel_areas |> 
  filter(Name == "vessel"|Classification == "vessel") |>
  group_by(scientificName, genus, other) |> 
  summarise(sample_Dh = sum(radius^5)/ sum(radius^4)) |> 
  group_by(scientificName) |> 
  summarise(mean_Dh = mean(sample_Dh, na.rm=T)) |> 
  left_join(climate_preferences, by = c("scientificName")) |> 
  # left_join(gbif_names %>% dplyr::select(scientificName, genus, family), by = c("scientificName")) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  drop_na() 

xylem_VLF <- vessel_areas |> 
  group_by(scientificName, other) |> 
  mutate(sample_lumen_area = max(Area.µm.2)) |> 
  filter(Name %in% c("vessel", "part")|Classification %in% c("vessel", "part")) |> 
  group_by(scientificName, other) |> 
  summarise(vessel_area = sum(Area.µm.2),
            sample_lumen_frac = vessel_area/max(sample_lumen_area)) |> 
  distinct() |>
  group_by(scientificName) |> 
  summarise(mean_VLF = mean(sample_lumen_frac, na.rm=T)*100) |> 
  left_join(climate_preferences, by = c("scientificName"))|> 
  distinct() |> 
  drop_na() 

# ggplot() +
#   geom_density(data = xylem_Dh |> filter(family_n_samples > 5), aes(MAP, col = family)) +
#   theme_bw() +
#   scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")

selected_families <- xylem_Dh |> group_by(family) |> summarise(n = n()) |> filter(n >= 10)

selected_genera <- xylem_Dh |> group_by(genus, family) |> summarise(n = n()) |> filter(n >= 10)
```

# Dh
## Dh mixed model
```{r}
# Data preparation
xylem_Dh_genus <- xylem_Dh |> 
  group_by(genus) |> 
  mutate(
    log_Dh = log(mean_Dh),
    log_MAP = log(MAP),
    genus_mean_MAP = mean(log(MAP)),
    genus_mean_Dh = mean(log(mean_Dh))
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    diff_from_genus_MAP = log_MAP - genus_mean_MAP,
  )

xylem_Dh_genus$genus <- as.factor(xylem_Dh_genus$genus)
xylem_Dh_genus$family <- as.factor(xylem_Dh_genus$family)

# Mixed model with genus-centering
xylem_Dh_mixed_model <- glmmTMB(log_Dh ~ genus_mean_MAP + 
                                  diff_from_genus_MAP +
                                  (1 | family) + 
                                  (diff_from_genus_MAP | genus),
                                data = xylem_Dh_genus,
                                family = gaussian())
```


## Dh mixed model testing
```{r}
xylem_Dh_regular_model <- glmmTMB(log_Dh ~ log_MAP, data = xylem_Dh_genus,
                                family = gaussian())

parameters(xylem_Dh_mixed_model)
summary(xylem_Dh_mixed_model)
r2(xylem_Dh_mixed_model)

parameters(xylem_Dh_regular_model)
summary(xylem_Dh_regular_model)
r2(xylem_Dh_regular_model)

check_model(xylem_Dh_mixed_model)

compare_performance(xylem_Dh_regular_model, xylem_Dh_mixed_model)
anova(xylem_Dh_regular_model, xylem_Dh_mixed_model)
```

```{r}
# 1. Align datasets to ensure identical N
valid_data <- xylem_Dh_genus[complete.cases(xylem_Dh_genus$log_MAP, 
                                            xylem_Dh_genus$genus_mean_MAP, 
                                            xylem_Dh_genus$diff_from_genus_MAP), ]

# 2. Refit both models on the aligned data
xylem_Dh_mixed_model <- glmmTMB(log_Dh ~ genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP + 
                                  (1 | family) + (diff_from_genus_MAP | genus),
                                data = valid_data, family = gaussian())

xylem_Dh_regular_model <- glmmTMB(log_Dh ~ log_MAP, 
                                  data = valid_data, family = gaussian())

# 3. Verify identical N
all.equal(nobs(xylem_Dh_mixed_model), nobs(xylem_Dh_regular_model)) # Should return TRUE

# 4. Compare AIC
AIC(xylem_Dh_mixed_model, xylem_Dh_regular_model)

```

## Dh family plot, mainly by Claude Sonnet 4.6
```{r}
# ── 1. Across-genus marginal effect ──────────────────────────────────────────
Dh_across_pred <- ggpredict(xylem_Dh_mixed_model, terms = "genus_mean_MAP [all]")

# ── 2. Family-level predictions ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Family only has a random intercept (1 | family), so we predict
# over genus_mean_MAP for each family
Dh_family_pred <- ggpredict(
  xylem_Dh_mixed_model,
  terms = c("genus_mean_MAP [all]", "family [all]"),
  type = "random"
)

Dh_family_pred <- Dh_family_pred |> left_join(selected_genera, by = c("group" = "family"))

# ── 3. Compute axis breaks from data range ────────────────────────────────────
Dh_y_range <- exp(range(xylem_Dh_genus$log_Dh, na.rm = TRUE))
Dh_x_range <- exp(range(xylem_Dh_genus$genus_mean_MAP + xylem_Dh_genus$diff_from_genus_MAP, na.rm = TRUE))

Dh_y_breaks <- log(log_breaks(n = 6)(Dh_y_range))
Dh_x_breaks <- log(log_breaks(n = 4)(Dh_x_range))

# Compute n per family, optionally restrict to only the families you're plotting
family_n <- xylem_Dh_genus |>
  dplyr::group_by(family) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::filter(family %in% selected_families$family) # Remove this line if you want n for ALL families


# ── 4. Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot() +
  # Raw data — light grey points
  geom_point(
    data = xylem_Dh_genus |> dplyr::select(-family),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_Dh),
    colour = "grey90", size = 1, alpha = 1
  ) +
  # Across-family line — black, same in every facet
  geom_line(
    data = as_tibble(Dh_across_pred),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted),
    colour = "black", linewidth = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # Selected family points — coloured
 geom_point(
    data = xylem_Dh_genus |> filter(family %in% selected_families$family),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_Dh,
    colour = family), size = 1, alpha = 1, shape = 1
  ) +
  # Family-level lines — coloured (intercept shifts only, parallel slopes)
  geom_ribbon(
    data = as_tibble(Dh_family_pred |> filter(group %in% selected_families$family)) %>% rename(family = group),
    aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = family),
    alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = as_tibble(Dh_family_pred |> filter(group %in% selected_families$family)) %>% rename(family = group),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted, colour = family),
    linewidth = 0.75, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = 2
  ) +
# sample size label
  geom_text(
    data = family_n,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("n = ", n)),
    hjust = -0.25, vjust = 1.15,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    size = 2.5,
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ family, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = Dh_y_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 1),
    name = expression(italic(D)[h] ~ "(μm)")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = Dh_x_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 0),
    name = "Mean Annual Precipitation (mm)"
  ) +
  labs(
    colour = "Family", fill = "Family",
    # title = "Hydraulic diameter ~ MAP",
    # subtitle = "Black = across-genus effect | Colour = family random effect"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = selected_families$color) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = selected_families$color) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    # strip.text = element_text(face = "italic")
  ) -> Dh_family_facet

Dh_family_facet
```

## Dh genus plot, mainly by Claude Sonnet 4.6
```{r}
# ── 1. Across-genus marginal effect ──────────────────────────────────────────
Dh_across_pred <- ggpredict(xylem_Dh_mixed_model, terms = "genus_mean_MAP [all]")

# ── Average within-genus response (population-level, no random effects) ───────
Dh_avg_within_pred <- ggpredict(
  xylem_Dh_mixed_model,
  terms = "diff_from_genus_MAP [all]"
  # type = "fixed" is default — random effects set to 0
)

# Recentre to global mean MAP so it sits on the same x-axis
global_mean_MAP <- mean(xylem_Dh_genus$genus_mean_MAP, na.rm = TRUE)

Dh_avg_within_scaled <- as_tibble(Dh_avg_within_pred) %>%
  mutate(x_scaled = x + global_mean_MAP)

# ── 2. Within-genus marginal effects per genus ────────────────────────────────
Dh_within_pred <- ggpredict(
  xylem_Dh_mixed_model,
  terms = c("diff_from_genus_MAP [all]", "genus [all]"),
  type = "random"
)

# ── 3. Scale within-genus x to across-genus x-axis ───────────────────────────
genus_means <- xylem_Dh_genus %>%
  group_by(genus) %>%
  summarise(genus_mean_MAP = mean(genus_mean_MAP, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

Dh_within_pred_scaled <- Dh_within_pred %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(genus = group) %>%
  left_join(genus_means, by = "genus") %>%
  mutate(x_scaled = x + genus_mean_MAP) |> 
  left_join(selected_genera, by = "genus")

# Full dataset with family info, minus genus column for background
family_background <- xylem_Dh_genus %>%
  select(-genus) %>%                    # removes genus so points appear in all panels
  left_join(

    by = "family"                       # rejoin by family so points appear in
  ) |>                                  # all genera panels within the same family
  # mutate(genus = factor(genus, levels = ordered_levels)) |> 
  filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus)

# Compute n per family, optionally restrict to only the families you're plotting
genus_n <- xylem_Dh_genus |>
  dplyr::group_by(genus) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus) # Remove this line if you want n for ALL families

    colour = "grey90", size = 1, alpha = 1
  ) +

  geom_line(
    data = as_tibble(Dh_across_pred),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted),
    colour = "black", linewidth = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
 #  # Selected family points — coloured
 # geom_point(
 #    data = family_background,
 #    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_Dh,
 #    colour = genus), size = 0.1, alpha = 1
 #  ) +
  # Selected genus points — coloured
 geom_point(
    data = xylem_Dh_genus |> filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_Dh),
```

# VLF
## VLF mixed model
```{r}
# Data preparation
xylem_VLF_genus <- xylem_VLF |> 
  group_by(genus) |> 
  mutate(
    log_VLF = log(mean_VLF),
    log_MAP = log(MAP),
    genus_mean_MAP = mean(log(MAP)),
    genus_mean_VLF = mean(log(mean_VLF))
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    diff_from_genus_MAP = log_MAP - genus_mean_MAP,
  )

xylem_VLF_genus$genus <- as.factor(xylem_VLF_genus$genus)
xylem_VLF_genus$family <- as.factor(xylem_VLF_genus$family)

# Mixed model with genus-centering
xylem_VLF_mixed_model <- glmmTMB(log_VLF ~ genus_mean_MAP + 
                                  diff_from_genus_MAP +
                                  (1 | family) + 
                                  (diff_from_genus_MAP | genus),
                                data = xylem_VLF_genus,
                                family = gaussian())

```

# VLF
## VLF mixed model testing
```{r}
xylem_VLF_regular_model <- glmmTMB(log_VLF ~ log_MAP,
                                data = xylem_VLF_genus,
                                family = gaussian())

parameters(xylem_VLF_mixed_model)
summary(xylem_VLF_mixed_model)
r2(xylem_VLF_mixed_model)


parameters(xylem_VLF_regular_model)
summary(xylem_VLF_regular_model)
r2(xylem_VLF_regular_model)

check_model(xylem_VLF_mixed_model)

compare_performance(xylem_VLF_regular_model, xylem_VLF_mixed_model)
anova(xylem_VLF_regular_model, xylem_VLF_mixed_model)
```

```{r}
# 1. Align datasets to ensure identical N
valid_data <- xylem_VLF_genus[complete.cases(xylem_VLF_genus$log_MAP, 
                                            xylem_VLF_genus$genus_mean_MAP, 
                                            xylem_VLF_genus$diff_from_genus_MAP), ]

# 2. Refit both models on the aligned data
xylem_VLF_mixed_model <- glmmTMB(log_VLF ~ genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP + 
                                  (1 | family) + (diff_from_genus_MAP | genus),
                                data = valid_data, family = gaussian())

xylem_VLF_regular_model <- glmmTMB(log_VLF ~ log_MAP, 
                                  data = valid_data, family = gaussian())

# 3. Verify identical N
all.equal(nobs(xylem_VLF_mixed_model), nobs(xylem_VLF_regular_model)) # Should return TRUE

# 4. Compare AIC
AIC(xylem_VLF_mixed_model, xylem_VLF_regular_model)

```


## VLF family plot, mainly by Claude Sonnet 4.6
```{r}
# ── 1. Across-genus marginal effect ──────────────────────────────────────────
VLF_across_pred <- ggpredict(xylem_VLF_mixed_model, terms = "genus_mean_MAP [all]")

# ── 2. Family-level predictions ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Family only has a random intercept (1 | family), so we predict
# over genus_mean_MAP for each family
VLF_family_pred <- ggpredict(
  xylem_VLF_mixed_model,
  terms = c("genus_mean_MAP [all]", "family [all]"),
  type = "random"
)

VLF_family_pred <- VLF_family_pred |> left_join(selected_genera, by = c("group" = "family"))

# ── 3. Compute axis breaks from data range ────────────────────────────────────
VLF_y_range <- exp(range(xylem_VLF_genus$log_VLF, na.rm = TRUE))
VLF_x_range <- exp(range(xylem_VLF_genus$genus_mean_MAP + xylem_VLF_genus$diff_from_genus_MAP, na.rm = TRUE))

VLF_y_breaks <- log(log_breaks(n = 6)(VLF_y_range))
VLF_x_breaks <- log(log_breaks(n = 4)(VLF_x_range))

# ── 4. Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot() +
  # Raw data — light grey points
  geom_point(
    data = xylem_VLF_genus |> dplyr::select(-family),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_VLF),
    colour = "grey90", size = 1, alpha = 1
  ) +
  # Across-family line — black, same in every facet
  geom_line(
    data = as_tibble(VLF_across_pred),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted),
    colour = "black", linewidth = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # Selected family points — coloured
 geom_point(
    data = xylem_VLF_genus |> filter(family %in% selected_families$family),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_VLF,
    colour = family), size = 1, alpha = 1, shape = 1
  ) +
  # Family-level lines — coloured (intercept shifts only, parallel slopes)
  geom_ribbon(
    data = as_tibble(VLF_family_pred |> filter(group %in% selected_families$family)) %>% rename(family = group),
    aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = family),
    alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = as_tibble(VLF_family_pred |> filter(group %in% selected_families$family)) %>% rename(family = group),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted, colour = family),
    linewidth = 0.75, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = 2
  ) +
# sample size label
  geom_text(
    data = family_n,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("n = ", n)),
    hjust = -0.25, vjust = 1.15,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    size = 2.5,
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ family, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = VLF_y_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 1),
    name = "VLF (%)"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = VLF_x_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 0),
    name = "Mean Annual Precipitation (mm)"
  ) +
  labs(
    colour = "Family", fill = "Family",
    # title = "Hydraulic diameter ~ MAP",
    # subtitle = "Black = across-genus effect | Colour = family random effect"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = selected_families$color) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = selected_families$color) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    # strip.text = element_text(face = "italic")
  ) -> VLF_family_facet

VLF_family_facet
```

## VLF genus plot, mainly by Claude Sonnet 4.6
```{r}
# ── 1. Across-genus marginal effect ──────────────────────────────────────────
VLF_across_pred <- ggpredict(xylem_VLF_mixed_model, terms = "genus_mean_MAP [all]")

# ── Average within-genus response (population-level, no random effects) ───────
VLF_avg_within_pred <- ggpredict(
  xylem_VLF_mixed_model,
  terms = "diff_from_genus_MAP [all]"
  # type = "fixed" is default — random effects set to 0
)

# Recentre to global mean MAP so it sits on the same x-axis
global_mean_MAP <- mean(xylem_VLF_genus$genus_mean_MAP, na.rm = TRUE)

VLF_avg_within_scaled <- as_tibble(VLF_avg_within_pred) %>%
  mutate(x_scaled = x + global_mean_MAP)

# ── 2. Within-genus marginal effects per genus ────────────────────────────────
VLF_within_pred <- ggpredict(
  xylem_VLF_mixed_model,
  terms = c("diff_from_genus_MAP [all]", "genus [all]"),
  type = "random"
)

# ── 3. Scale within-genus x to across-genus x-axis ───────────────────────────
genus_means <- xylem_VLF_genus %>%
  group_by(genus) %>%
  summarise(genus_mean_MAP = mean(genus_mean_MAP, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

VLF_within_pred_scaled <- VLF_within_pred %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(genus = group) %>%
  left_join(genus_means, by = "genus") %>%
  mutate(x_scaled = x + genus_mean_MAP) |> 
  left_join(selected_genera, by = "genus")


# Full dataset with family info, minus genus column for background
family_background <- xylem_VLF_genus %>%
  select(-genus) %>%                    # removes genus so points appear in all panels
  left_join(
    xylem_VLF_genus %>% distinct(genus, family),
    by = "family"                       # rejoin by family so points appear in
  ) |>                                  # all genera panels within the same family
  # mutate(genus = factor(genus, levels = ordered_levels)) |> 
  filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus)

# ── 5. Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot() +
  # Raw data — light grey points
    geom_point(
    data = xylem_VLF_genus |> dplyr::select(-genus),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_VLF),
    colour = "grey90", size = 1, alpha = 1
  ) +
  # Across-genus line — black, same in every facet
  geom_line(
    data = as_tibble(VLF_across_pred),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted),
    colour = "black", linewidth = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
 #  # Selected family points — coloured
 # geom_point(
 #    data = family_background,
 #    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_VLF,
 #    colour = genus), size = 0.1, alpha = 1
 #  ) +
  # Selected genus points — coloured
 geom_point(
    data = xylem_VLF_genus |> filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_VLF), 
    col = "grey40", size = 1, alpha = 1, shape = 1
  ) +
  # Within-genus lines — coloured, scaled to global x-axis
  geom_ribbon(
    data = VLF_within_pred_scaled |> filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus),
    aes(x = x_scaled, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
    fill = "grey50",
    alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = VLF_within_pred_scaled |> filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus),
    aes(x = x_scaled, y = predicted),
    col = "grey30",
    linewidth = 0.75, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = 2
  ) +
  # Family-level lines — coloured (intercept shifts only, parallel slopes)
  geom_line(
    data = as_tibble(VLF_family_pred |> filter(group %in% selected_genera$family)) |> rename(family = group),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted, col = genus),
    linewidth = 0.75, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = 2
  ) +
# sample size label
  geom_text(
    data = genus_n,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("n = ", n)),
    hjust = -0.25, vjust = 1.15,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    size = 2.5,
  ) +
  # Facet by genus
  facet_wrap(~ genus, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = VLF_y_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 1),
    name = "VLF (%)"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = genus_colours$color) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genus_colours$color) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = VLF_x_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 0),
    name = "Mean Annual Precipitation (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    # strip.text = element_text(face = "italic")
  ) -> VLF_genus_facet
```

```{r}
plot_interaction <- function(model, data) {
  model_p <- predict.lm(model, data, se.fit = T)
  
  pred_data <- bind_cols(data, model_p)
  
  return(pred_data)
}
```

```{r}
austraits <- read_rds("data/austraits-5.0.0.rds")

height_data <- extract_trait(austraits, "plant_height")

species_heights <- height_data$traits |> 
  filter(taxon_name %in% xylem_Dh$apc_name) |>

xylem_Dh_height <- xylem_Dh |> left_join(species_heights, by = c("apc_name"= "taxon_name"))

height_logged <- ggplot(data = xylem_Dh_height, aes(mean_height, mean_Dh)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F, col = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(col = MAP), size = 1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_gradient2(low = "red", mid = "dark grey", high = "blue", midpoint = median(log(xylem_Dh_height$MAP)), trans = "log") +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Maximum plant height (m)") + 
  ylab(D[h]~" (µm)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14)) 

height_unlogged <- ggplot(data = xylem_Dh_height, aes(mean_height, mean_Dh)) +
  # geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F, col = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(col = MAP), size = 1) +
  # scale_x_log10() +
  # scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_gradient2(low = "red", mid = "dark grey", high = "blue", midpoint = mean(log(xylem_Dh_height$MAP)), trans = "log", breaks = c(222, 1037, 3368)) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Maximum plant height (m)") + 
  ylab(D[h]~" (µm)") +
  labs(colour = "MAP (mm)") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14)) 

height_logged + height_unlogged + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a", tag_prefix = "(", tag_suffix = ")") & theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 10))

ggsave("figures/Dh_height_MAP.png", scale = 1.5, width = 15.94, height = 7.34, units = "cm")
```


## Sankey diagram for distribution of species in dataset
```{r}
## Code adapted from https://r-graph-gallery.com/sankey-diagram.html
links <- read.csv("data/sankey_links.csv", header = T)

nodes <- data.frame(
  name=c(as.character(links$source), 
  as.character(links$target)) %>% unique()
)

links$IDsource <- match(links$source, nodes$name)-1 
links$IDtarget <- match(links$target, nodes$name)-1
 
sankey_plot <- sankeyNetwork(Links = links, Nodes = nodes,
              Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget",
              Value = "value", NodeID = "name", 
              sinksRight=FALSE, width = 600, height = 600, fontSize = 20, fontFamily = "Arial")

sankey_plot
```


## Zanne et al. (2010) comparison
```{r}
zanne_data <- read.csv("data/zanne_data.csv", header = T)

# Calculating same variables on our data
comparison_data <- vessel_areas |> 
  group_by(apc_name, other) |> 
  mutate(area_mm = Area.µm.2/1000000, 
         total_area = max(area_mm)) |> 
  filter(Name == "vessel") |> 
  group_by(apc_name, other, total_area) |>
  mutate(n=n(),
         mean_area = mean(area_mm, na.rm=T)) |> 
  mutate(n_per_area = n/total_area,
         area_n_ratio = mean_area/n_per_area) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  group_by(apc_name) |> 
  summarise(N = mean(n_per_area, na.rm = T),         # Vessel density
            A = mean(mean_area, na.rm = T)) |>       # Mean area 
  drop_na() |> 
  left_join(apc_names[c("accepted_name", "family")], by = c("apc_name" = "accepted_name")) |>
  distinct()

ggplot() +
  geom_hex(data = zanne_data, aes(x = N, y = A), bins = 10, col = "light grey", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "forestgreen") +
  geom_point(data = comparison_data, aes(x = N, y = A), size = 0.05) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_wrap(~family) +
  xlab("Vessel density"~ (mm^-2)) +
  ylab("Total vessel area"~ (mm^2)) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.5, 0.15),
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  labs(fill = "Count")


ggsave("figures/zanne_plot.png", scale = 1, width = 15.94, height = 15.94, units = "cm",dpi = 330)
```


## Dataset statistics
```{r}
data_dir <- "/Users/elijahmagistrado/OneDrive - UNSW/images"

all_image_names <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "_x.jpg", recursive = T) |> 
  as.data.frame() 

names(all_image_names)[1] <- "file_name"

# Correcting for strange formatting of image folders
non_eucalypts <- all_image_names |>
  separate(file_name, c("family", "other"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") |>
  separate(other, c("species", "other"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") |> 
  filter(!grepl("/", species)) |> 
  distinct(family, species)

eucalypts <- all_image_names |>
  separate(file_name, c("family", "other"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") |>
  separate(other, c("species", "other"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") |> 
  filter(grepl("/", species)) |> 
  separate(species, c("other", "species"), sep = "/", extra = "merge") |> 
  separate(species, c("family2", "species"), sep = " ", extra = "merge") |> 
  distinct(family, species)

species_merged <- bind_rows(non_eucalypts, eucalypts)

images_apc_names <- update_taxonomy(species_merged$species, resources = resources) |>
  filter(grepl("accepted|synonym|variant", taxonomicStatusClean)) |> distinct(canonicalName)

# Species names with typos
apc_names |> filter(!canonicalName %in% images_apc_names$canonicalName)

# Total number of species
nrow(species_merged)

# Number of native species
nrow(apc_names |> distinct(canonicalName))

# Number of species in selected families
xylem_areas |> distinct(family, apc_name) |> group_by(family) |> summarise(n = n())
xylem_areas |> distinct(apc_name, species_name) |> filter(apc_name != species_name) |> nrow()


image_count <- vessel_areas |> filter(scientificName %in% xylem_Dh$scientificName) |> 
  filter(Name == "vessel"|Classification == "vessel") |> 
  group_by(family, genus, scientificName, other) |> summarise(n=n())
```

## Moving unprocessed images to new folder
```{r}
processed_images <- list.files("/Volumes/Extension/Elijah honours/QuPath images", recursive = T, full.names = T) |> basename()

original_dataset <- list.files("/Users/elijahmagistrado/OneDrive - UNSW/images", recursive = T, full.names = T) |> as.data.frame()

names(original_dataset)[1] <- "file_name"

matching_files <- data.frame()

for (image in processed_images) {
  matching_file <- original_dataset |> filter(grepl(image, file_name, fixed = T))
  
  matching_files <- bind_rows(matching_files, matching_file)
}

for (image in matching_files) {
  file.copy(from = image, to = "/Volumes/Extension/Elijah honours/Original images/")
}
```
